prompt:
59M with MRSA septic arthritis of the knee, washed out in OR yesterday. Came in dehydrated with a prerenal AKI, now on fluids. Nephrology thinks the kidneys will recover. Vancomycin per pharmacy.

You are the pharmacist dosing vancomycin for this patient. Target: AUC24 400-600 mg*h/L (MIC assumed 1 mg/L), per our institutional AUC protocol. Each day you get that morning's labs, then you set the regimen that starts that day. Use the tools: get_labs, simulate, submit_dose. Allowed intervals: 8, 12 or 24 h. A loading dose is allowed on day 0 only. This episode runs 4 days (day 0 to day 3).

grader.q_unit: L/h (verdict must match under h-1; see VALIDATION.md)

sources.fact: PK model, parameters, validated covariate ranges
